purpose: Mphase-only matched power arm for the subject-level mean reducer, with median retained as a descriptive robustness contrast.

seed_namespace.rule: Every formal matched world seed is in the frozen range and outside every excluded range; P0 and P4 share the same world seed and checkpoint.

P0.role: matched zero phase-concentration injection; not zero amplitude

injection.kernel_formula: h(t)=sqrt(2)*sin(pi*(t-0.10)/0.40), t in [0.10,0.50] s, zero outside
injection.phi: one Uniform(-pi,pi) phase per pair, shared by P0 and P4
injection.epsilon: von Mises(0,kappa); kappa=0 is Uniform(-pi,pi), kappa=4 is Best-Fisher rejection sampling
injection.signal_point: raw 1000-Hz synthetic signal before anti-alias filtering and 250-Hz downsampling
injection.event_subset: all covariate rows with source_complete==1; boundary-invalid windows are skipped
injection.intersection_rule: Every phaseGood & mx event is source_complete and has a valid [0.10,0.50] injection window because phaseGood enforces the wider filter support; therefore n_injected_phase_intersection is explicitly asserted equal to n_phase_events, not inferred from a duplicated count.

epsilon_resultant_check.level: per-world per-arm mean over pairs with epsilon_count>=1000, plus loose per-pair caps
epsilon_resultant_check.rationale: Uniform resultant mean ~0.886/sqrt(n) ~0.0203 with per-pair SD ~0.011 at n~1900; world means over 351 pairs have SE ~0.0006 (observed: P0 0.0208+/-0.0033 max 0.0282, P4 0.86365+/-0.0012). World-mean tolerances are >=8 sigma and catch sampler-level bugs (the 2026-09-10 acceptance-rule bug moved R(4) from 0.8635 to 0.576); per-pair caps are non-firing corruption sentinels. Implementation QC, not a scientific gate.

production_mphase.filter: third-order zero-phase Butterworth within each continuous clean block
production_mphase.p_value: p_two_sided(2) only; Mpower/family rejection is excluded

stream_partition.base: one common Threefry stream synthesizes subject/session/pair nuisance, pair phase/polarity and 1/f backgrounds; base synthesis occurs once per matched world
stream_partition.injection: arm-local pair-keyed Threefry stream derived from SHA256(contract_sha256|world_seed|arm|subject|session_id|pair_id|phase_injection); variable rejection draws cannot advance base or metric streams; the pair key includes subject and session because pair_name labels repeat across subjects
stream_partition.metric: P0 and P4 receive independent clones initialized from the identical post-synthesis base stream state
stream_partition.crn_scope: background, pair nuisance, schedule/support and metric-surrogate randomness are paired; von Mises epsilon draws are distribution-correct arm-local draws
stream_partition.additive_draws: deterministic kernel consumes no random draws

checkpoint.unit: one matched world containing complete P0 and P4 results
checkpoint.format: MATLAB -v7.3; write world_%03d.mat.tmp then atomic move to world_%03d.mat
checkpoint.final_requires: both arms complete, identity/hash/stream assertions pass, no stale tmp residue
checkpoint.resume: only a complete matched checkpoint with exact identity may be reused; partial single-arm checkpoints are invalid

inference.subject_reducer: same finite pair rows and subject inclusion for both reducers
inference.paired_contrast: FPR_P4 - FPR_P0 within matched world and run; Newcombe method 10 two-sided 95% CI

preregistered_decision.rule_A: Rule A — P0 mean 零校准（必要条件）：60 个 P0 world 的 mean-reducer p_two_sided(2) <= 0.05 计数形成 FPR；R1 和 R2 的 CP 95% interval 均须包含 0.05。这里的 P0 是“有匹配 transient、但 phase concentration 为零”的注入下校准；它不是 Stage A 的纯 null/无注入零臂，两者不能互换引用。若失败，Stage B 只能标为 NOT_CONFIRMED，不得用 P4 的结果掩盖。
preregistered_decision.rule_B: Rule B — mean 的相位功效存在性（主规则）：对 matched world 的 P4/P0 mean rejection indicators，FPR_P4 - FPR_P0 的 Newcombe method-10 95% interval 在 R1 和 R2 均须有下界 > 0。这是一条方向性存在性规则，不另设未经校准的最低 power 百分比或“实用重要性”门槛；同时报告两臂 FPR、四格计数和完整 CI。
preregistered_decision.rule_B_feasibility: n=60 的可行性预期（解析量级，不是额外判定门）：κ=4 给出 R(4)^2≈0.746 的 phase-resultant target；结合 G06 的 A_G06=4.61799281479342 µV、exp(a+bz_e) 的事件增益和既定 1/f background，这个 matched transient 的相位集中信号应在 pair-level PPC 中留下明显的正向尺度，而 P0 的 κ=0 只保留相同能量/时间包络的随机相位噪声。因此，在 60 个 matched world 下，若实现与该 SNR 量级一致，P4 相对 P0 的 rejection-rate 差应达到可被 95% Newcombe 区间分离的量级（预期为“多数 P4 world 拒绝、P0 接近 alpha 基线”，而不是仅有几个百分点的微小差异）。这只是可检验的设计期预期：若实际 P4−P0 差仍接近零，或 P0 本身偏离校准，必须如实报告功效边界，不能调大幅度、κ、事件子集或 world 数来补救。
preregistered_decision.rule_C: Rule C — median 仅描述性：同样导出 P0/P4 median 的 FPR、CP interval、配对四格和 Newcombe interval，并与 mean 并排显示；不纳入 CONFIRMED/NOT_CONFIRMED 判定，也不触发 conditional branch。median 的结果可说明稳健性是否一致，但不能事后改变主 estimand。

status.CONFIRMED: 60 个 matched world 完整，validator PASS，Rule A 与 Rule B 在 R1/R2 均通过；Rule C 只作为描述性输出。
status.NOT_CONFIRMED: 运行完整且 validator PASS，但 Rule A 或 Rule B 至少一项失败。
status.INCOMPLETE: 缺 checkpoint、身份/hash/配对不完整、validator 失败或导出不完整。

validator_checklist: contract/parent/schedule/input SHA-256 match checkpoint; no Stage A/P0-6 path is written
exactly 60 matched checkpoints, each with exactly P0 and P4, unique seeds and no tmp residue
P0/P4 pair/session/subject/run/T/bad-segment/selector identity and base background fingerprint match
kappa, A_G06 numeric value, grid_id, frequency, envelope and gain constants match contract; numeric amplitude and grid_id are both checked
independent injection and event-count checks; P0 epsilon uniform and P4 kappa=4 distribution
base and metric stream states are not changed by injection; arm-local draw provenance is recorded
independent mean/median, pair diagnostics, exact sign-flip column-2 p, FPR/CP and P4-P0 Newcombe recomputation
summary TSVs and decision agree; smoke observed-statistic separation is implementation evidence only and never a tuning gate
each pair epsilon resultant satisfies the frozen P0/P4 tolerance; event-count intersection assertion is checked
world rows carry and independently check base_stream_state_hash, metric_stream_initial_state_hash, truth A_G06_uV and truth grid_id
P0/P4 metric initial hashes are equal and injection_stream_seed is unique by arm and pair

engineering.performance_budget: Stage A 528 s/world; 60 matched worlds with two arms estimated 1.5-2 h at 12 workers; profile synthesis/injection/metric timing
engineering.smoke: 2+2 smoke and benchmark world are implementation/performance checks only; per-world P4-P0 observed-statistic difference is implementation-health evidence, never power estimation or a gate for kappa, amplitude, event subset or world count
